selection.selection_rule: minimum mean Brier among candidates meeting both point-estimate margins; if none, minimize maximum margin violation then mean Brier then grid index

limitations: Internal prospective revision freeze informed by all earlier results; no external preregistration or blind development claim.

Known-family primary test uses genuinely new paths; smooth_drift and hidden_sensor_flip are newly authored generator families excluded from all candidate selection and assessed only as exploratory transfer.

Two experts and all gate configurations use only current pre-outcome probabilities and past realized outcomes; no scenario names, boundaries, latent states, true probabilities, or future outcomes enter forecasts.

Validation chooses both fixed hazard and gate settings. All60 gate candidates share the same220 validation paths; test banks are separate. Candidate selection uncertainty is not a cross-development replication.
Normal Monte Carlo intervals use independent seeds as clusters; eleven correlated known-family outcomes are averaged within each seed. Transfer scenarios are excluded from the primary average.

The revised target is an average Brier gain0.0001 over the original adaptive policy plus worst-excess-harm reduction0.0003 versus fixed; these are frozen engineering choices, not general utility thresholds.

The original v3 target, mean Brier gain0.0005 versus fixed and all-scenario harm below0.001, is reported separately and unchanged. A revised-target success cannot be relabeled as original-target success.
Simultaneous normal bounds quantify only the13 specified synthetic families and seed design; no guarantee over arbitrary environments or distribution shift.

Brier exp-concavity bound applies only to eta<=0.5 without restart; larger selected learning rates and positive restart have no claimed version of that bound. Convex mixing remains pointwise within the expert forecast hull.
Timing includes verification overhead. The revised policy requires running both experts plus its gate; gate-only runtime is not the deployment cost.
No inference about consciousness, persistent identity, physics, clinical benefit, or general intelligence follows.
